title: [spec-gap][R-19-028/029] SOS cancel flow (same hold + confirm screen) and H-tier timeout unimplemented
description: spec/19-device-ux.md §8: SOS never auto-cancels; explicit cancel = same hold again + confirm screen (E/O only; H has no cancel, only timeout). Evidence: no cancel flow exists anywhere — the button engine keeps LED ownership across presses (ux_button_zephyr.c:58-63) but no second-hold handler, no confirm screen (no screens at all), and no SOS device-state machine linking to the wire-level 'cancel' alert type that sos_alert.c already encodes. The H-tier timeout value is UNSPECIFIED in the spec (no number given) — per §8 SOS semantics may block on a human, so the timeout needs a human decision or a ux-default bead before implementation. Fix sketch: SOS device-state (armed/cancelled) owned app-side; cancel = second 2s hold → confirm screen (E/O) with same-hold-again grammar; H tier: timeout expiry clears LED to restore state; emit spec-18 cancel alert on cancel.
